title: Piwigo plugin manifest
description: Declarative manifest for Piwigo 17+ plugins. One file per plugin at plugins/<id>/plugin.json. Read by PluginRegistry at load time; validated via opis/json-schema.

$schema.description: URI pointing at this schema for IDE/editor autocomplete. Optional; not enforced.

id.description: Unique identifier. Must match the plugin directory basename.

name.description: Human-readable plugin name shown in the admin UI.

description.description: Single-line description shown in the admin UI.

license.description: SPDX license identifier (e.g. 'GPL-3.0-or-later', 'MIT', 'Apache-2.0'). Required — the fork rejects plugins distributed without a license.

minPiwigo.description: Minimum Piwigo branch this plugin targets, formatted 'MAJOR.MINOR' (e.g. '17.0'). PluginRegistry compares this against AppInfo::branchFromVersion(AppInfo::VERSION); mismatches are refused.

hasSettings.description: Whether the plugin exposes a settings page: true (admin), false (none), or 'webmaster' (webmaster-only). Default: false.

require.description: Map of dependency names to composer-style version constraints. Keys are 'piwigo' for core or 'plugin/<id>' for other plugins.

psr-4.description: PSR-4 namespace prefix to directory map, relative to the plugin root.

autoload.description: Autoload configuration for the plugin's source files.

namespace.description: PHP namespace declared in the plugin's Version*.php migration files.

path.description: Directory containing Version*.php migration files, relative to the plugin root.

migrations.description: Optional Doctrine-style migrations shipped by the plugin. PluginRegistry runs un-applied migrations on activate() and reverses them on uninstall(); applied versions are tracked in piwigo_plugin_migrations keyed on (plugin_id, version).
